mapper.sql: s.id as relayId,s.account_id as accountId,s.name,s.description,s.status, s.current_version_id as currentVersionId,s.access_secret_id as accessSecretId,s.grant_mode as grantMode, s.auth_epoch as authEpoch,s.admin_disabled as adminDisabled,s.last_test_at as lastTestAt, s.last_test_status as lastTestStatus,s.last_test_error as lastTestError, s.last_test_version_id as lastTestVersionId,s.created_at as createdAt,s.updated_at as updatedAt, sec.display_suffix as tokenSuffix

v.id as versionId,v.relay_service_id as relayId,v.version_no as versionNo, v.base_url as baseUrl,v.protocol_version as protocolVersion,v.capabilities,v.endpoints, v.timeout_ms as timeoutMs,v.max_response_bytes as maxResponseBytes,v.created_at as createdAt
mapper.select: select 1 from sys_user where user_id=#{accountId} and status='0' and del_flag='0' for update

select from p_relay_service s join p_secret sec on sec.id=s.access_secret_id where s.account_id=#{accountId} and s.status!='DELETED' order by s.created_at desc,s.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from p_relay_service where account_id=#{accountId} and status!='DELETED'
select from p_relay_service s join p_secret sec on sec.id=s.access_secret_id where s.id=#{relayId} and s.account_id=#{accountId} and s.status!='DELETED'
select from p_relay_service s join p_secret sec on sec.id=s.access_secret_id where s.id=#{relayId} and s.account_id=#{accountId} and s.status!='DELETED' for update
select from p_relay_service s join p_secret sec on sec.id=s.access_secret_id where s.id=#{relayId} for update
select from p_relay_version v where v.account_id=#{accountId} and v.id=#{versionId}
select from p_relay_version v where v.account_id=#{accountId} and v.relay_service_id=#{relayId} order by v.version_no desc
select application_id as applicationId,scopes,status from p_relay_grant where account_id=#{accountId} and relay_service_id=#{relayId} order by application_id
select coalesce(max(version_no),0)+1 from p_relay_version where relay_service_id=#{relayId}
select count(*) from p_application where id=#{applicationId} and account_id=#{accountId} and status!='DELETED' and admin_disabled=0

select (select count(*) from p_app_config c join p_relay_version v on v.id=c.llm_relay_version_id or v.id=c.asr_relay_version_id where v.relay_service_id=#{relayId}) + (select count(*) from p_voice_version vv join p_relay_version v on v.id=vv.relay_version_id where v.relay_service_id=#{relayId}) + (select count(*) from p_resource_reference r join p_relay_version v on v.id=r.resource_id where r.resource_type='RELAY_VERSION' and r.state in ('RESERVED','CONFIRMED') and v.relay_service_id=#{relayId})

select count(*) from p_resource_reference r join p_app_config c on c.id=r.resource_id and c.application_id=#{applicationId} join p_application a on a.id=c.application_id and a.account_id=#{accountId} and a.status='ACTIVE' and a.admin_disabled=0 where r.account_id=#{accountId} and r.holder_type='SESSION' and r.holder_id=#{sessionId} and r.resource_type='APP_CONFIG' and r.state='CONFIRMED' and ((#{capability}='LLM' and c.llm_relay_version_id=#{versionId}) or (#{capability}='ASR' and c.asr_relay_version_id=#{versionId}))
select request_hash as requestHash,resource_id as resourceId,status from p_api_idempotency where account_id=#{accountId} and scope=#{scope} and request_id=#{requestId}
select id,ciphertext,nonce,auth_tag,key_version,algorithm,status from p_secret where id=#{secretId} and account_id=#{accountId} and purpose='RELAY_ACCESS' and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: update p_secret set ciphertext=#{secret.ciphertext},nonce=#{secret.nonce},auth_tag=#{secret.authTag}, key_version=#{secret.keyVersion},algorithm=#{secret.algorithm},display_suffix=#{suffix}, revision=revision+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{secret.id} and account_id=#{accountId} and purpose='RELAY_ACCESS' and status='ACTIVE'
update p_secret set status='DISABLED',updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{secretId} and account_id=#{accountId} and purpose='RELAY_ACCESS' and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into p_relay_version (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,relay_service_id,version_no,base_url,protocol_version, capabilities,endpoints,timeout_ms,max_response_bytes,config_hash,created_by) values (#{id},utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),#{accountId},#{relayId},#{versionNo},#{baseUrl},'1', cast(#{capabilities} as json),cast(#{endpoints} as json),#{timeoutMs},#{maxResponseBytes},#{hash},#{actorId})
mapper.update: update p_relay_service set current_version_id=#{versionId},auth_epoch=auth_epoch+1, last_test_at=null,last_test_status=null,last_test_error=null,last_test_version_id=null,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{relayId} and account_id=#{accountId} and auth_epoch=#{epoch} and status!='DELETED'
update p_relay_service set grant_mode=#{grantMode},auth_epoch=auth_epoch+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{relayId} and account_id=#{accountId} and auth_epoch=#{epoch} and status!='DELETED'
update p_relay_grant set status='REVOKED',updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{accountId} and relay_service_id=#{relayId} and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into p_relay_grant (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,relay_service_id,application_id,scopes,status) values (#{id},utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),#{accountId},#{relayId},#{applicationId},cast(#{scopes} as json),'ACTIVE') on duplicate key update scopes=values(scopes),status='ACTIVE',updated_at=utc_timestamp(3)
mapper.update: update p_relay_service set status=#{status},auth_epoch=auth_epoch+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{relayId} and account_id=#{accountId} and auth_epoch=#{epoch} and status!='DELETED'
update p_relay_service set auth_epoch=auth_epoch+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{relayId} and account_id=#{accountId} and auth_epoch=#{epoch} and status!='DELETED'

update p_relay_service set auth_epoch=auth_epoch+1,last_test_at=null, last_test_status=null,last_test_error=null,last_test_version_id=null,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{relayId} and account_id=#{accountId} and auth_epoch=#{epoch} and status!='DELETED'
update p_relay_service set admin_disabled=#{disabled},auth_epoch=auth_epoch+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{relayId} and status!='DELETED'

update p_relay_service set last_test_at=utc_timestamp(3),last_test_status=#{status}, last_test_error=#{error},last_test_version_id=#{versionId},updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{relayId} and account_id=#{accountId} and current_version_id=#{versionId} and auth_epoch=#{epoch} and status!='DELETED'
mapper.insert: insert into p_outbox (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,event_id,event_type,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,schema_version,trace_id,payload,status,next_run_at) values (#{id},utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),#{accountId},#{eventId},'RELAY_ADMIN_RESTRICTION_CHANGED', 'RELAY',#{relayId},1,#{eventId},cast(#{payload} as json),'PENDING',utc_timestamp(3))

insert into p_outbox (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,event_id,event_type,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,schema_version,trace_id,payload,status,next_run_at) values (#{id},utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),#{accountId},#{eventId},'RELAY_STATUS_CHANGED', 'RELAY',#{relayId},1,#{eventId},cast(#{payload} as json),'PENDING',utc_timestamp(3))
